svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="6nyfEb2FJ4fxrwT7xxj-"> <mxGraphModel dx="7740" dy="4970" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml HikeBase_Deployment
!theme plain
skinparam backgroundColor #FAFAFA
skinparam nodeBackgroundColor #EAF4FB
skinparam nodeBorderColor #2980B9
skinparam componentBackgroundColor #FEF9E7
skinparam databaseBackgroundColor #F9EBEA
skinparam databaseBorderColor #E74C3C

title HikeBase – Deployment diagram

node \"Klientské zařízení\n(Telefon / Prohlížeč)\" as Client #D5F5E3 {
 component \"Mobilní aplikace\n(React Native)\" as MobileApp
 component \"Webová aplikace\n(React / SPA)\" as WebApp
 component \"Offline Cache\n(SQLite / Service Worker)\" as OfflineCache
 note right of OfflineCache
 NFR: Offline dostupnost tras
 bez internetového připojení
 end note
}

node \"CDN\n(Cloudflare / AWS CloudFront)\" as CDN #E8DAEF {
 component \"Statické soubory (JS, CSS)\" as StaticFiles
 component \"Offline GPS balíčky (KML/GeoJSON)\" as GpsFiles
 note right
 NFR: Načítání < 2s
 Geografická distribuce
 end note
}

node \"Load Balancer\n(Nginx / AWS ALB)\" as LB #D6EAF8 {
 component \"Reverse Proxy + SSL Termination\" as Proxy
 note right
 NFR: HTTPS/TLS 1.3
 Bezpečná komunikace
 end note
}

node \"Aplikační cluster\n(Docker / Kubernetes)\" as AppCluster {
 node \"Backend Server 1\n(Java Spring Boot)\" as App1 {
 component \"REST API\" as API1
 component \"JWT Auth Service\" as JWT1
 component \"GPS Service\" as GPS1
 }
 node \"Backend Server 2\n(Java Spring Boot)\" as App2 {
 component \"REST API\" as API2
 component \"JWT Auth Service\" as JWT2
 }
 note right of AppCluster
 NFR: Horizontální škálování
 99.9% SLA dostupnost
 Auto-scaling při špičce
 end note
}

node \"Cache Server\n(Redis)\" as Cache #FDEDEC {
 database \"Session Cache (JWT tokeny)\" as SessionDB
 database \"Query Cache (oblíbené trasy)\" as QueryDB
 note right
 NFR: Latence API < 200ms
 end note
}

node \"Databázový cluster\n(AWS RDS / PostgreSQL)\" as DBCluster #FEF9E7 {
 database \"Primary DB (PostgreSQL 15)\" as PrimaryDB
 database \"Replica DB (Read replica)\" as ReplicaDB
 note right of DBCluster
 NFR: Data v EU (Frankfurt)
 GDPR compliance
 Šifrování AES-256 at-rest
 Zálohy každých 6 hodin
 end note
}

node \"Externí služby\" as External #F0F3F4 {
 component \"Platební brána (Stripe API)\" as PaymentGW
 component \"E-mail (SendGrid / AWS SES)\" as EmailSvc
 component \"Push notifikace (Firebase FCM)\" as PushSvc
 component \"Mapy API (OpenStreetMap)\" as MapAPI
}

node \"Monitoring (Grafana / CloudWatch)\" as Monitor #EAFAF1 {
 component \"Log agregace\" as Logs
 component \"Metriky + Alerting\" as Metrics
}

' Komunikace
Client --> CDN : \"HTTPS (statický obsah)\"
Client --> LB : \"HTTPS REST API + JWT\"
CDN --> LB : \"Origin requests\"
LB --> App1 : \"HTTP (interní) round-robin\"
LB --> App2 : \"HTTP (interní) round-robin\"
App1 --> Cache : \"Redis TCP 6379\"
App2 --> Cache : \"Redis TCP 6379\"
App1 --> PrimaryDB : \"JDBC šifrované TCP 5432\"
App2 --> PrimaryDB : \"JDBC šifrované TCP 5432\"
PrimaryDB --> ReplicaDB : \"Streaming replikace\"
App1 --> PaymentGW : \"HTTPS REST\"
App1 --> EmailSvc : \"HTTPS REST\"
App1 --> PushSvc : \"HTTPS REST\"
App2 --> MapAPI : \"HTTPS REST\"
App1 --> Monitor : \"Logy + metriky\"
App2 --> Monitor : \"Logy + metriky\"
DBCluster --> Monitor : \"DB metriky\"
MobileApp --> OfflineCache : \"SQLite – offline mód\"
WebApp --> OfflineCache : \"Service Worker cache\"

@enduml",
 "format": "svg"
}" id="DvJG6Qj9Ns2umr3M3_BK-9"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1620" width="5726.78" x="20" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
